question: A room has a floor in the shape of a rectangle (18 m × 10 m), with a triangular extension on one end. The triangle has a base of 10 m and height of 6 m. What is the total area of the floor?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Split shape = Rectangle + Triangle

Rectangle area = 18 × 10 = 180

Triangle area = (1 ÷ 2) × 10 × 6 = 30

Total = 180 + 30 = 210

**∴ Answer = 210 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rectangle: Length = 18 m, Breadth = 10 m

Triangle: Base = 10 m, Height = 6 m

**Formula:**

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

Area of triangle = (1 ÷ 2) × Base × Height

 
 18 m 10 m 6 m 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Rectangle area = 18 × 10 = 180 m²

⇒ Triangle area = (1 ÷ 2) × 10 × 6 = 30 m²

⇒ Total area = 180 + 30 = 210 m²

**∴ Final Answer: 210 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

**Composite Figures:** Break complex shapes into basic shapes like rectangle and triangle.

**Triangle Area Rule:** Area = (1 ÷ 2) × base × height.

**Unit Consistency:** Always keep units same before calculation.

**Mensuration Tip:** Add areas when shapes are joined, subtract when removed.
